scripts.eas:env:production: pnpm dlx eas-cli env:list production --format long
scripts.build: node scripts/with-android-sdk-env.mjs pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile production --platform android --local
scripts.build:preview:android: pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform android
scripts.build:production:android: pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile production --platform android
scripts.build:production:all: pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile production --platform all
scripts.build:local:preview:android: node scripts/with-android-sdk-env.mjs pnpm dlx eas-cli env:exec preview "pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform android --local"
scripts.build:local:production:android: node scripts/with-android-sdk-env.mjs pnpm dlx eas-cli env:exec production "pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile production --platform android --local"
scripts.build:local:production:android:env-file: sh -c 'if [ -f .env.local ]; then set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; fi; node scripts/with-android-sdk-env.mjs pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile production --platform android --local'
scripts.check: oxlint src test modules scripts packages --threads=2 && oxfmt --check src test modules scripts packages package.json app.config.js metro.config.js app.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json && tsc --noEmit
